settings.title: Settings
settings.notSaved: {n} value not saved | {n} values not saved
settings.storageRefused: This browser did not store the change; it applies until the page is closed.
settings.intro: Changes save automatically in this browser and apply to the next test.

preset.title: Test preset
preset.continuous: {streams}, Standard ramp · one direction until stopped · {pings}

phases.title: Phases
phases.help: Idle latency runs first. Turn off a phase to test the others; at least one stays on.
phases.helpContinuous: Continuous runs the one direction chosen above. Idle latency runs first when it is on.

continuous.directionCaption: Continuous measures one direction until you stop it.
continuous.runLengthCaption: Optional. None by default. A whole number of minutes, hours or days, 1 minute to 7 days.

streams.title: Parallel streams
streams.caption: Auto ramps 1 → 2 → 4 → 6 streams and stops when adding streams no longer helps. Fixed runs 1–{max}. Single shows one connection.

duration.title: Duration per direction
duration.caption: A direction ends after the minimum once results are stable, and runs up to the maximum on slow or noisy links.

cap.title: Data cap per test
cap.caption: Useful on metered mobile links. A direction stops early when the cap is reached and the result is marked.

autoStart.title: Auto-start on page load
autoStart.caption: Shows a countdown first, so you can cancel. Also available as {param}.

label.title: Result label
label.caption: Pre-fills the label of every result in this browser, as the label link parameter does for one page load.

warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.caption: Auto ends warm-up once throughput settles. Samples during warm-up are discarded.

pings.title: Ping count
pings.caption: Used for idle latency and jitter. Preset default: {n}.

overhead.title: Overhead compensation
overhead.caption: Adds estimated protocol overhead to measured throughput. Shown next to every number when not 0 %.

share.title: Shareable link
share.caption: Opens BitGauge with the settings that differ from the defaults.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy the link; select it and copy it by hand.

changed.title: Changed from defaults
changed.confirmBody: {n} setting returns to its default: {names}. Your test history is not affected. | {n} settings return to their defaults: {names}. Your test history is not affected.

errors.duration: Enter whole seconds from 5 s to 10 min (600 s).
errors.minAboveMax: Must be at most the maximum ({max} s).
errors.maxBelowMin: Must be at least the minimum ({min} s).
errors.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
errors.label: Use at most {max} characters.
errors.runLength: Run length must be 1 minute to 7 days.
